final:
type Expr = Num(v: int) | Add(l: Expr, r: Expr) | Mul(l: Expr, r: Expr)

-- Evaluates an expression tree. Int overflow panics.
eval_expr(e: Expr) -> int =
  ex eval_expr(Num(v: 7)) == 7
  ex eval_expr(Add(l: Num(v: 1), r: Mul(l: Num(v: 2), r: Num(v: 3)))) == 7
  match e
    Num(v:) -> v
    Add(l:, r:) -> eval_expr(e: l) + eval_expr(e: r)
    Mul(l:, r:) -> eval_expr(e: l) * eval_expr(e: r)

test_eval_expr() =
  assert eval_expr(Num(v: 7)) == 7
  assert eval_expr(Add(l: Num(v: 1), r: Mul(l: Num(v: 2), r: Num(v: 3)))) == 7
  assert eval_expr(Mul(l: Add(l: Num(v: 2), r: Num(v: 3)), r: Num(v: 4))) == 20
